意味: サーマルビアは、部品の熱を裏面の銅へ逃がす穴です。パッドの中に格子状に置き (穴 0.3mm くらい)、裏面の同じネットの銅 (ゾーン) につなぐと、熱が基板全体に広がります。基板エディタの「サーマルビアを置く」で自動で置けます

{}.{} is a thermal pad (area {area:.1}mm²).
Recommended: {need} or more thermal vias (now {have})
{pour_note}
Meaning: thermal vias are holes that carry the part's heat to copper on the bottom side. Place them in a grid inside the pad (about 0.3mm holes) and connect them to the same net's copper (zone) on the bottom, and the heat spreads across the board. "Place thermal vias" in the board editor places them automatically
